title: Media Inquiry — Channel 11 News

fields.message: This is Laura Chen from Channel 11 News. We’re getting calls from viewers saying ambulances are being diverted to other hospitals and that your EHR is locked by hackers. Is Ottawa River under a cyberattack? Is patient information safe? We go live at 08:00. I need a statement now.

instructorNote: This inject tests the PIO’s adherence to the media protocol and control of messaging. Watch for any deviation from the approved holding statement, premature confirmation of data safety, or admission of ransom demand.
